fact: The INE's 2023 annual report (Bissau, 1 February 2024) records that the first statistical bulletin on social protection (social security records, INPS) was being finalised through the GITEPS inter-institutional group trained in September 2023, and that a Ministry of Public Health working group with Justice, INE, WHO, UNICEF and UNFPA was set up to integrate health system data, allowing INE to prepare a delegated body at the Ministry.
title: Relatório Anual de Actividades 2023
